ranked_facts.why: The presence of inspiratory stridor is more commonly associated with viral upper respiratory infections, such as croup, which is a leaf exemplar of candidate B1. In contrast, bacterial upper respiratory infections, such as those represented by candidate B2, may present with different symptoms.

However, it does contrast with other rare causes (candidate B5) that might be considered if COVID-19 were a possibility.
